title: State of Kerala v. N.M. Thomas

content.caseIdentity: State of Kerala v. N.M. Thomas, (1976) 2 SCC 310
content.holding: Articles 15(4) and 16(4) are not exceptions to formal equality, but emphatic restatements and facets of substantive equality.
content.relevance: Shift from formal equality to substantive equality in Indian jurisprudence.

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 1160 of 1974; 1975 INSC 226; (1976) 2 SCC 310; 1976 (1) SCR 906.
